project.name: e2e-tests
project.description: Black-box end-to-end tests that drive BOTH deployed services over real HTTP and real Kafka. They depend on neither service's classes on purpose: the point is to exercise the artifacts as shipped, across the process boundary the unit and integration suites cannot cross. Every test skips (never fails) when the compose stack is not reachable, so `mvn -B test` and the deterministic build gate stay green on a machine with no Docker daemon.
